properties.description: Established in 1941, this design office serves as the steward of the Eames legacy, preserving and extending the vision of Charles and Ray Eames. The studio oversees the production of iconic furniture, films, and exhibitions that defined the mid-century modern aesthetic. By focusing on the intersection of play, curiosity, and industrial functionality, the entity maintains its influence across global architecture and interior design markets. It serves as both a repository of design history and an active participant in contemporary cultural discourse.
properties.short_description: Eames Office is a design studio established by Charles and Ray Eames, dedicated to preserving and extending their legacy in furniture, architecture, films, and exhibitions.

results.name: Charles & Ray Eames: 1907-1978, 1912-1988 : Pioneers of Mid-Century Modernism

properties.description:
Eventually everything connects - people, ideas, objects, etc.,... the quality of the connections is the key to quality per se.

- Charles Eames

... everything hangs on something else.

- Ray Eames

Nothing says modernist perfection like an Eames design. Though they are best known to the general public for their furniture, the husband and wife duo of Charles and Ray Eames (1907-78 and 1912-88, respectively) were also forerunners in the fields of architecture, industrial design, photography, and film. This book covers all the aspects of their illustrious career, from the earliest furniture experiments and molded plywood designs to the Case Study Houses to their work for Herman Miller and films such as the seminal short, Powers of Ten.
properties.short_description: A detailed account of Charles and Ray Eames' contributions to modern design and architecture.

short_descriptions.value: Ein ausführlicher Überblick über die Beiträge von Charles und Ray Eames zum modernen Design und zur Architektur.
